title: サウジアラビアRCにむけて

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: The Saudi Arabia R.C.—a 1,600-meter race open only to junior year Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I can't imagine us faltering here. Besides, my sights are set far higher: the Satsuki Sho, the first race of the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Accordingly, I will pace myself for a 2,000-meter race instead. I trust that you do not object.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Only Symboli Rudolf could be this confident going into a graded race…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Knock, knock.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Come in.

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Manager
text_block_list.text: Hi, President. I… Um…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Oh, there you are.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I apologize for calling you over here. I heard that you came to show your support.

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Manager
text_block_list.text: Y-yes… That's right, I…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Allow me to introduce you, Trainer. This is the student council's general manager. I believe I've mentioned her before.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Quite the opposite, actually. She only joined the student council recently.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Apparently, I inspired her so much that she wanted to join me in making a difference at the academy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, I do remember Symboli Rudolf mentioning her… but she seems a little less enthusiastic than I'd imagined.

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Manager
text_block_list.text: Um… President? I wanted to apologize… You know, for the other day…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Was that weighing on your mind? I assure you, you have nothing to apologize for.

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Manager
text_block_list.text: But you trusted me to handle that assignment… and in the end, you had to look over my shoulder the whole time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It sounds like she needed Symboli Rudolf to help her with some student council business.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hardly. I gave you a little advice, that's all. You did the lion's share yourself.

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Manager
text_block_list.text: If you say so, but I shouldn't be adding to your workload just before a race…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Your thoughtfulness is commendable, but I assure you, you need not worry.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Watch me race, and you'll see that I have suffered no ill effects.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: 1,600 meters isn't so far. I trust you'll watch me to the end.

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Manager
text_block_list.text: O-of course!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Well, then. Trainer, shall we be off?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I hope you'll also keep a keen eye on my performance today, so that we may prepare for what lies ahead.
